tunic.title: Метрополитен-музей · Андские туники
tunic.passage: The earliest preserved tunics from Peru come from the Ocucaje basin of the Ica valley. Dry desert climate and layered funerary wrapping contributed to their preservation.

ice.title: Служба национальных парков США · Находки в тающем льду
ice.passage: An ice patch in Wrangell-St. Elias preserved a 650-year-old birch bark basket. Ice patch archaeology surveys emerging artifacts.

iceHuman.title: Археологический музей Южного Тироля · Тело Эци
iceHuman.passage: Ötzi is a naturally preserved wet mummy in glacier ice. The museum has preserved him in a specially designed cold cell since 1998.

preservation.title: Служба национальных парков США · Естественная сохранность находок
preservation.passage: Examples include dry cave animal remains, frozen remains, organisms preserved in amber, and animals preserved in natural asphalt.

wood.title: Historic England · Почему древесина сохраняется под землёй
wood.passage: Explains survival of archaeological wood in permanently waterlogged environments and the risks if water level drops and oxygen returns.

char.title: Historic England · Обугленные балки длинного кургана Хадденем
char.passage: Research report on the composition and conservation potential of charred structural timbers from Haddenham Long Barrow, Cambridgeshire.

chemistry.title: Historic England · Минерализованные остатки растений и беспозвоночных
chemistry.passage: Technical guidance describes plant and invertebrate material replaced by calcium phosphate in archaeological deposits.

field.title: Historic England · Археологические раскопки
field.passage: Excavation is a controlled examination of buried deposits and features. Historic England excavators record spatial information and photographs alongside interpretation.

anthro.title: Смитсоновский институт · Антропология и общественные науки
anthro.passage: Anthropology studies people and their societies in the past and present. Museum learning resources include linking nature and culture and study of life across cultures.

analogy.title: Служба национальных парков США · Археологический глоссарий Юго-Запада
analogy.passage: The ethnoarchaeology entry explains that research on living societies can inform archaeological interpretations, e.g. comparison of butchery patterns.

geo.title: Historic England · Геоархеология
geo.passage: Earth-science methods used by geoarchaeologists include soil micromorphology, heavy mineral analysis and particle-size analysis to characterize sediments.

conserve.title: Historic England · Консервация археологических находок
conserve.passage: Historic England conservators advise on care and conservation of archaeological materials, from site handling to treatment.

wallpaint.title: Historic England · Обработка римской расписной штукатурки
wallpaint.passage: Conservation report describes removing adhering soil from fragments of Roman painted plaster to aid consolidation.

tomb.title: Служба древностей Киклад · Археология Миконоса
tomb.passage: The Mycenaean tholos tomb at Angelika yielded ceramics, gold necklaces and semi-precious stone seals and informs understanding of funerary architecture.

edfu.title: Министерство туризма и древностей Египта · Эдфу
edfu.passage: Edfu Temple was devoted to Horus. The building includes hypostyle halls, a transverse hall and a sanctuary.

plant.title: Historic England · Археоботаника
plant.passage: Archaeobotany uses macrofossils including grains, seeds and chaff, and also wood, charcoal and microfossils. The page describes identification facilities and the modern reference seed collection.

zoo.title: Historic England · Зооархеология
zoo.passage: Zooarchaeology studies archaeological animal bones. Historic England maintains thousands of comparative vertebrate skeletons.

photo.title: Historic England · Фотограмметрия и другие методы съёмки
photo.passage: Photogrammetry uses images to measure and record heritage objects and features, including 3D reconstruction from overlapping photos.

strata.title: Historic England · Методы археологической геофизики
strata.passage: Magnetic variations can reveal burned iron minerals and filled ditches. Resistance instruments inject a small current through ground electrodes; moist fills and masonry often yield different responses. GPR records return time and amplitude of reflected radiofrequency pulses and can survey paved surfaces.

casts.title: Археологический парк Помпей · Слепки
casts.passage: The ash hardened around the bodies; as they decayed, hollows remained. Plaster was poured into these voids. Fiorelli perfected the technique; the cast-making program began in 1863.

woodChar.title: Historic England · Древесина и уголь из археологических отложений
woodChar.passage: The study describes anatomical identification of charcoal and what it can reveal about the wood selected for use.

find.title: Служба национальных парков США · Как археологи находят памятники
find.passage: Archival sources include government documents, maps, journals, photographs and other historical sources.

early.title: Служба национальных парков США · Полуземлянки и ранние пуэбло
early.passage: Some rooms had wooden lattice plastered with mud, with large stone slabs supporting the base. Masonry overlies an earlier pithouse at the site.

salado.title: Служба национальных парков США · Памятники культуры Саладо
salado.passage: Excavated rooms could have adobe-set stone walls, clay-lined hearths, postholes, storage pits and sub-floor pits.

analysis.title: Висконсинский университет в Ла-Кроссе · Анализ каменных находок
analysis.passage: Shows core, waste flakes, hammerstone, bifaces, points, end scraper, drill and utilized flake as distinct archaeological material. Sorting lithic objects helps interpret activity and technology.

fauna.title: Oxford Archaeology · Отчёт о раскопках в Уикфорде
fauna.passage: Table 10 records NISP and MNI plus each as a percentage by taxon; nearby tables record element and weight in grams.

bath.title: Археологический парк Помпей · Помпеи после извержения
bath.passage: The Moregine baths were discovered during construction of the Naples–Salerno motorway on the southern outskirts of modern Pompeii.

pueblo.title: Служба национальных парков США · Поселение предков пуэбло
pueblo.passage: The site contained bedrooms, kitchens, storage rooms and a kiva.
